label: Rent.com Scraper
title: Rent.com Scraper: Rentals, Floor Plans & Availability
metaDescription: Scrape Rent.com rentals from any search or listing link: rent, beds, baths, availability, deals, floor plans with unit rents, amenities and fees.
intro: Paste a Rent.com search or listing link and get each rental's rent, beds, baths, availability, deals and location, plus floor plans with unit rents, amenities, fees, pet policy and leasing phone. Filters in the link are applied exactly.
useCases: Compare rents per bedroom count across neighbourhoods
Track concessions and deals in a market

faq.q: Can I use my own Rent.com search?
faq.a: Yes. Set your filters on rent.com (city, ZIP, neighborhood, county, college or military base; price, bedrooms, bathrooms, property type, pets, amenities, move-in date), copy the link and paste it.

faq.q: Does it show the rent for the floor plan I want?
faq.a: Yes. On a search with bedroom, bathroom, price or size filters, each row says which floor plans match and the lowest and highest matching rent, not only the building's range.

faq.q: Can I scrape a single apartment or house?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a property link or a single unit link in the same box as your search links.

faq.q: How many listings can I get?
faq.a: You set a maximum per run, from 1 to 100,000. Listings that were taken down or links that cannot be used become marked, unpaid rows.

faq.q: Do I need a Rent.com account?
faq.a: No. It reads public listings; no login or cookies.

officialApi: Rent.com has no public listings API. This actor returns the rentals any visitor sees, with rents, floor plans, amenities and the leasing office details.
